lead.headline: Game shelves lean into adventures and strategy
lead.dek: Computer Gaming World's March-April issue put Zork, Ultima II, The Cosmic Balance, and a 1983 game-industry report in front of readers as stores balanced arcade action with deeper Apple II play.
lead.body: During the week of March 21-27, 1983, the strongest personal-computer culture signal came from the game rack. Computer Gaming World Vol. 3 No. 2 carried a report on computer games in 1983, coverage of The Cosmic Balance, an overview of Zork, and a review of Ultima II. The mix shows why late-March shoppers saw computer games as more than arcade imitations: role-playing, text adventures, and strategy titles were becoming durable reasons to own a disk drive.
